name: Benedict Lorenzo Vasari
original_name: ベネディクト・ ロレンツォ・ヴァザーリ
source:
The mysterious mafia member who loves beauties.

Assigned by the family's higher-ups to oversee the takeover of Tenkai District, he carries out his mission with an unpredictable style, marked by unique speech patterns and eccentric behavior. 
Even his own people within the gang find him impossible to predict.

He’s the type to not sweat the small stuff and always focuses on the bigger picture.

Part of the PHOENIX mafia
